summary: Scope-hijacked datepicker executes obfuscated bundled payload via downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: @ornikar/react-modern-calendar-datepicker@3.2.2 is a scope-hijacked copy of the upstream Kiarash-Z react-modern-calendar-datepicker library with an added install-time dropper. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), writes it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line bun-compiled JS blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated with string-array rotators (MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())), numeric/string dispatcher arrays, and a hc1jfK9 decoder — none of this is present in the upstream library. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root but are not declared in package.json `files`, and the upstream library sources under lib/ are preserved unchanged to reduce visibility during review. The @ornikar scope makes the package appear first-party to consumers of Ornikar tooling. On `npm install` of this package, the obfuscated payload executes on the installer's host under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based scanners and giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
